conceptZh: 布忍者躲得很爛，後面的小影子慢半拍學他，最後兩個都乖乖坐好。
object: a tiny felt ninja and a smaller copycat twin
morph: the ninja and his one-beat-late twin mirror each pose and both end sitting neatly under 乖
creativeAngle: 模仿遊戲：慢半拍的影子讓兩人一起「乖」起來。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a warm cream background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 乖 as the only text on screen, drawn in forest green solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a tiny black felt ninja tiptoes in and hides behind a single thin flower, convinced he is invisible while his pointy hood sticks out; the first 乖 is spoken as the top strokes of 乖 slide down from above. 1.7-3.4s: a smaller grey felt twin pops up and mimics every move one beat late, bonking noses; the second 乖 is spoken as they both reach for the same bottom stroke, swap sides, and the glyph's lower strokes click in. 3.4-5s: the ninja points sharply to sit up, the twin sits late, and 乖乖 is spoken as both fold their felt hands and two gold star stickers pop onto their foreheads (animated shapes only). 5-8s: hold; the stars twinkle on the ninjas while the glyph stays still. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "乖、乖、乖乖" (ㄍㄨㄞ、ㄍㄨㄞ、ㄍㄨㄞ ㄍㄨㄞ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 乖 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.

conceptZh: 太空人玩偶想衝去坐好在紅色軟墊上，卻半路飄起來「碰」一聲撞上綠色發射塔，撞落的桿子掉下來排成「乖」，他最後乖乖坐在墊子上一動也不動。
object: a bouncy astronaut toy in a fishbowl helmet charging at a red sit-still cushion but drifting up and bonking into a tall green launch tower of stacked rods
morph: the crash shakes eight green rods and a hooked bar loose from the tower; they drop straight down and lock into 乖 in the center while the flattened astronaut peels off, floats down onto the cushion and sits perfectly still
creativeAngle: 上一版是布忍者安靜模仿、幾乎沒有動作；這次改成完整的「衝刺撞牆」肢體笑料：太空人想乖乖坐好卻一直飄起來，撞塔震落零件成字，最後「乖乖」這個詞由他終於坐定不動、雙手疊好來演出，聲音與畫面同一個故事。
promptEn:
An 8-second 2D cartoon clip on a warm cream background with soft pastel lighting. Only one piece of text ever appears: the Traditional Chinese glyph 乖, centered, uncropped, built from solid forest-green rods, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Lead: a chubby toy astronaut with a round fishbowl helmet, stubby white suit, orange boots and a big goofy grin; his comic flaw is that he floats off the ground at the worst moments. Three things on screen only: the astronaut, a tall slim green launch tower of stacked green rods standing center-frame, and a plump red cushion on the floor at the lower right edge.

0-1.5s: the astronaut stands at the far left, spots the red cushion across the frame, points at it with both hands, stamps his orange boots into the floor and leans way back in an exaggerated wind-up, helmet wobbling.
1.5-3s: first try: he sprints, but after three steps his boots lift off and he paddles the air in place like a balloon, legs running on nothing. He grabs his own boots, yanks himself down, lands with a squeak, and winds up even bigger, cheeks puffed.
3-4.5s: the big charge: he rockets right, drifts upward mid-run, sails over the cushion's path and slams face-first into the tall green tower with a soft squashy BONK; his body pancakes flat, the helmet rings and wobbles. The voice says the first 乖 right at the impact as the tower shudders and green rods pop loose. The rods fall straight down and settle into 乖 at center: a short slanted cap on top, a horizontal bar, one tall central stem, a short vertical with two short bars on the left, and a 匕-shaped slant with an upward hook on the right. The voice says the second 乖 as the last hooked bar clicks into place.
4.5-5.5s: the flattened astronaut peels off the tower like a sticker, re-inflates with a pop, floats dizzily down with little stars circling his helmet, and plops onto the red cushion at the lower right, well clear of the strokes.
5.5-8s: hold. The glyph 乖 stays perfectly still and fully readable. On the cushion the astronaut sits bolt upright, knees together, hands folded neatly in his lap, and the voice says 乖乖 exactly as he freezes into that perfect sit-still pose with a proud grin. Near the end his bottom starts drifting up off the cushion again; he grabs the cushion edges and pulls himself back down, shooting the camera a sheepish smile.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "乖、乖、乖乖" (ㄍㄨㄞ、ㄍㄨㄞ、ㄍㄨㄞ ㄍㄨㄞ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word. No other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no English. Soft cartoon squeak and boing effects only, quieter than the voice. Bright but not neon palette, no white blowout, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.
